correctness.rationale: For x>0 the increasing change z=bx-1/x maps (0,infty) bijectively to R and makes z′=F(z)-u, with sign F′ proportional to -1+B y^2(1-2y), B=bK^2, y=x/K. The cubic y^2(1-2y) has unique maximum 1/27 at y=1/3. Consequently F strictly decreases if B<=27 and scalar integrated-control comparison shows low-pressure-first minimizes terminal prey for any positive initial state, positive durations and finite list; high-first maximizes. At B>27, equal short blocks have local difference tau^2(u_+-u_-) (g′h-h′g)+O(tau^3), with coefficient r x^2[-1+b x^2(1-2x/K)]/(1+b x^2)^2, yielding two roots and both ordering signs. Independent sympy confirmed coefficient and exact r=K=1,b=54,u=20,30 witness, coefficient 10/441, and threshold root expansion.
